malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Object pooling is a legitimate performance optimization technique, but only when pooled objects are thoroughly reset and isolated between uses. In secure implementations, session-specific data is always cleared before reuse.
key_indicators: WebSocket object returned to pool while still in use or not fully closed
Subsequent connections reusing pooled WebSocket objects with residual state
Presence of session data from one user in another user's WebSocket session
